info.name: Lab Unity API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Lab Unity platform.

**Roles:**
- `ADMIN` — Full platform access
- `SUPPLIER` — Can create marketplace listings and advertisements
- `USER` — Regular authenticated customer

**Auth flow:**
1. Call `POST /auth/login` to receive `accessToken` + `refreshToken`
2. Set the relevant token variable (`adminToken`, `sellerToken`, `customerToken`)
3. All protected requests are pre-configured with Bearer auth using `{{accessToken}}`

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` defaults to `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints — registration, login, token refresh and logout. These endpoints do not require an existing session.

request.description:
Create a new account. `profileType` options: `laboratory`, `hospital`, `clinic`, `supplier`, `professional`, `other`. Password must be ≥8 chars with one uppercase letter, one digit, and one symbol.

Rate-limited.

Exchange credentials for an access token and refresh token. The test script automatically saves tokens to collection variables.

Rate-limited.
Issue a new access token and rotate the refresh token. Send the current `refreshToken`.
Revoke a refresh token, ending the session. No Bearer token required.
Returns the JWT payload for the authenticated user (id, role, email). Requires a valid access token.

item.name: 🌐 Public
item.description: Endpoints that are publicly accessible without authentication, or with optional authentication.

request.description: Returns server status and process uptime.
Publicly readable blog list. Optional authentication enriches the response. Supports pagination and category filter.
Retrieve a single blog post by its URL slug. Fully public.
Returns available subscription plan definitions (FREE, MONTHLY, YEARLY) with pricing. No authentication required.

item.name: 📊 Dashboard
item.description: Dashboard summary and analytics endpoints for each role.

item.name: 📁 Admin
item.description: Admin-only dashboard and analytics. Requires `adminToken` (ADMIN role).

request.description: Returns headline KPIs: active users, new subscribers this month, active subscriptions, monthly revenue (EUR), new job listings, and total marketplace listings.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Returns a 12-month time series for user growth and revenue, used for analytics charts.
Returns all platform configuration key-value pairs.
Fetch a single platform setting by key.
Create or update a platform setting. `value` accepts any valid JSON.

item.name: 📁 Supplier
item.description: Supplier (Seller) dashboard: their advertisement campaigns and marketplace listings.

request.description: List all advertisements owned by the authenticated supplier.
List all marketplace listings created by the authenticated supplier.
List recruitment jobs posted by the authenticated supplier.

item.name: 📁 Customer
item.description: Customer (User) dashboard: profile overview, subscriptions, and activity.

request.description: Returns the full profile of the authenticated user.
Returns the current subscription status and plan for the authenticated user.
List feed posts created by the authenticated user.
List accepted connections of the authenticated user.

item.name: 🛡️ Admin
item.description: All endpoints restricted to the ADMIN role. Use `{{adminToken}}` for these requests.

request.description: Paginated list of all users. Supports filtering by `role`, `status`, and subscription `plan`.
Retrieve a specific user's full profile by UUID.
Activate, suspend, or ban a user account. `status` options: `ACTIVE`, `SUSPENDED`, `BANNED`.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "The Future of Lab Automation",
  "category": "Technology",
  "excerpt": "How automation is reshaping modern laboratory workflows.",

  "image": "https://example.com/images/blog-1.jpg",

  "publish": true

request.description: Publish a new blog post. `slug` is auto-generated if not provided.
Partially update a blog post. All fields are optional.
Permanently delete a blog post by ID.
Paginated list of all content reports. Filter by `status`.
Aggregate stats on reports: totals per status, top violation reasons, etc.
Get details of a specific report including the target content snippet.
`status` options: `PENDING`, `UNDER_REVIEW`, `RESOLVED`.
Apply a moderation action to a report. `action` options: `WARN`, `SUSPEND`, `BAN`, `REMOVE_CONTENT`, `DISMISS`.
Approve or reject an advertisement submitted by a supplier. `status` options: `ACTIVE`, `REJECTED`, `EXPIRED`. Include `rejectionReason` when rejecting.
Retrieve all platform-wide configuration settings.
Create or update a platform setting. `value` accepts any valid JSON scalar or object.

`type` options: `LIKE`, `LOVE`, `CELEBRATE`, `SUPPORT`, `INSIGHTFUL`, `CURIOUS`. Sending the same reaction again removes it (toggle).

Send a connection request to another user.

Create a new direct conversation and send the first message.

`plan` options: `MONTHLY`, `YEARLY`.
